answers.free_guess: low wide box or chest seen isometrically, maybe a table or crate
answers.why: Wide, low block with a flat lid and a slightly wider base, like a chest on a plinth. No other asset is this wide and flat.

answers.free_guess: pillar or pedestal with wide top and base and a narrow waist
answers.why: Hourglass outline with a flared capital and base and a straight shaft. Nothing else in the list has this shape.

answers.free_guess: dome-shaped blob, slime or jelly creature
answers.why: Round dome that spreads into a skirt at the floor, the classic slime outline.

answers.free_guess: cluster of lumps, a rock pile or mushroom cluster
answers.why: Irregular, low cluster of rounded lumps with no symmetry, which fits a masonry pile.

answers.free_guess: standing humanoid with something on its right side (shield?) and thin legs
answers.why: Humanoid with a squarish helm, a shield bump at the side and a slim, gappy lower body that could be bony legs. Separating it from G was a coin flip.

answers.free_guess: low wide object on stubby legs with small dots floating above, possibly a cauldron or beast
answers.why: Bowl-like body on separate legs, with detached specks above that read as sparks or embers.

answers.free_guess: stocky hooded or helmeted humanoid, mage or guard
answers.why: Bulkier humanoid with a brim sticking out from the head, which fits a kettle helm. Assigned by elimination against E.

answers.free_guess: small teardrop or sack with a cross shape on top, maybe a potion or grave marker
answers.why: Small teardrop that narrows into flickering tips. It is too small to be a prop, so a flame fits best by elimination.

answers.free_guess: tall elongated hexagon, a door, coffin, crystal or barrel
answers.why: Upright solid with chamfered top and bottom corners, an isometric cylinder. The only cylindrical prop left is the barrel.
